KO.rationale: Coca-Cola is a high-quality defensive franchise with excellent brand moat, 64-year dividend increase streak, and strong profitability (25.9% net margin, 40.4% ROE, 61.4% gross margin). Q2 2025 showed solid sequential growth (+12.6% QoQ revenue, +14.3% QoQ EPS). However, the stock is trading near the top of its 1-year P/E range (28.7x vs 23.2-30.0x window), making it expensive vs its own recent history. The upcoming Q2 2026 earnings on July 28 is a near-term catalyst, but consensus expectations of 92-93c EPS and $13.1B revenue are already well-telegraphed, limiting surprise potential. The Fairlife ransomware incident (July 16) and Mexico excise tax risk add uncertainty. Rising 10-year Treasury yields (4.71%) reduce the relative appeal of dividend stocks. The stock has already rallied +8.8% over the past quarter, suggesting much of the positive is priced in. Net: solid business but stretched valuation caps upside.
